title: THE FAMILY COURTS ACT, 1964
source_url: UNKNOWN - fill in where you downloaded this PDF
long_title: AN ACT to make provision for the establishment of Family Courts.
preamble:
Preamble:- WHEREAS, it is expedient to make provision for the establishment of Family Courts for the expeditious settlement and disposal of disputes relating to marriage and family affairs and for matters connected therewith;
It is hereby enacted as follows:—

notes.text: This Act was passed by the West Pakistan Assembly on 30th June, 1964; assented to by the Governor of West Pakistan on 14th July, 1964; and, published in the West Pakistan Gazette (Extraordinary), dated 18th July, 1964, pages 2427-34.
